quarterly_data.signal: Orders and order backlog, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report; at selling prices): orders received JPY 1,989,530 million (+15.6% year on year) and order backlog at March 31, 2026 JPY 446,169 million (+55.2% from a year earlier). Capacitors: orders JPY 1,063,569 million (+27.7%), backlog JPY 269,158 million (+89.5%) - the company states the capacitor backlog rose sharply because multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) orders grew, mainly for servers, and orders exceeded sales. Inductors / EMI filters: orders JPY 234,078 million (+15.3%), backlog JPY 42,219 million (+34.2%), on inductor orders mainly for smartphones and servers and EMI filter orders mainly for servers and mobility. Components segment backlog JPY 311,377 million (+79.5%); Devices and Modules backlog JPY 130,890 million (+20.3%).

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term Plan 2027 targets (annual securities report): revenue JPY 2,000,000 million, operating margin of 18% or more and after-tax ROIC of 12% or more, against results of JPY 1,830,856 million, 15.4% and 9.7% in the year ended March 2026 (JPY 1,743,352 million, 16.0% and 10.0% a year earlier). Management states revenue beat the prior year but operating margin and ROIC fell; the business environment is uncertain on trade policies and Middle East geopolitical risk, but medium- to long-term demand for electronic components is expanding, and the company will strengthen profitability and productivity toward the targets. Under the plan it aims to establish No. 1 share in capacitors and in inductors / EMI filters and high sales growth in functional devices, RF / communications and energy / power, with edge devices, mobility and IT infrastructure as its base fields. Capital allocation progress: cumulative capex JPY 247.8 billion and strategic investments (executed and approved) JPY 28.3 billion; management states data-center demand has expanded greatly as more electronic components are mounted in AI servers and peripheral equipment, and it will keep investing in Components and Devices and Modules.
quarterly_data.figure: Medium-term Plan 2027: revenue JPY 2,000,000 million; operating margin 18% or more; ROIC 12% or more

quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facilities (annual securities report): planned investment in significant new and upgraded facilities over the year after March 31, 2026 is JPY 250,000 million. Plants, each started March 2026 with completion planned March 2027: Izumo Murata Manufacturing (Izumo, Shimane) component production equipment JPY 58,000 million; Fukui Murata Manufacturing (Echizen, Fukui) component production equipment JPY 32,000 million; Murata Electronics (Thailand) component and device / module production equipment JPY 20,000 million; Murata's Yasu plant (Shiga) raw-material and device / module production equipment JPY 15,000 million; Wuxi Murata Electronics (China) component and device / module production equipment JPY 12,000 million; Philippine Manufacturing Co. of Murata component production equipment JPY 8,000 million. The company states these are mainly capacity-expansion, new-product and rationalisation investments; added capacity is not stated because the product items are too varied.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 250,000 million planned; Izumo JPY 58,000 million; Fukui JPY 32,000 million; Thailand JPY 20,000 million; completion March 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Segment and product results, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): Components revenue JPY 1,175,235 million (+12.6%) with operating profit JPY 315,132 million (+14.5%); Devices and Modules revenue JPY 655,981 million (-5.9%) with an operating loss of JPY 26,491 million (operating profit JPY 9,995 million a year earlier); Other revenue JPY 69,701 million (+3.6%), operating loss JPY 6,806 million. By product: capacitors JPY 936,418 million (+12.6%; MLCCs up across a wide range of applications, centred on servers), 51% of consolidated revenue; inductors / EMI filters JPY 223,316 million (+11.0%); RF and communications JPY 394,829 million (-11.0%; RF modules down for smartphones and PCs, resin multilayer substrates down for smartphones); functional devices JPY 107,074 million (+9.5%; sensors up for mobility, actuators up for computers). Operating profit was held down by product price declines and a goodwill impairment loss in the surface acoustic wave (SAW) filter business, offset by higher utilisation from increased production and by cost reductions. Segment pre-tax ROIC: Components 22.4% (21.2% a year earlier), Devices and Modules -3.5% (1.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: Components revenue JPY 1,175,235 million (+12.6%), operating profit JPY 315,132 million; capacitors JPY 936,418 million (+12.6%); Devices and Modules operating loss JPY 26,491 million

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue by application, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report; company estimates, prior year regrouped into the new application categories): communications JPY 652,957 million (-3.1%; smartphone MLCCs and inductors up, RF modules and resin multilayer substrates down); mobility JPY 474,484 million (+4.8%; automotive MLCCs, sensors and inductors up); computers JPY 310,392 million (+28.4%; server MLCCs and lithium-ion batteries up, PC RF modules down); home electronics JPY 142,694 million (+0.1%); industrial and other JPY 250,329 million (+7.8%). Production (at selling prices) totalled JPY 1,814,535 million (+4.4%), of which capacitors JPY 923,244 million (+8.6%). Management states component demand grew in data-center applications as the number of electronic components mounted in AI servers and peripheral equipment increased, while the automotive market held firm on AD/ADAS progress despite slower xEV growth.

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 247,778 million in total - Components JPY 187,749 million, Devices and Modules JPY 55,295 million, Other JPY 4,734 million; mainly production equipment expansion and rationalisation JPY 89,824 million, land and buildings JPY 97,370 million and R&D equipment JPY 17,030 million. Purchases of property, plant and equipment of JPY 244,619 million went mainly to capacity expansion and production-building construction. Construction in progress includes JPY 19,540 million for building the Moriyama Innovation Center. No retirement or sale materially affecting production capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 247,778 million; Components JPY 187,749 million; land and buildings JPY 97,370 million

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 158,870 million in the year ended March 2026 (JPY 149,274 million a year earlier) - Components JPY 57,083 million, Devices and Modules JPY 93,048 million, Other JPY 8,739 million. In the year the company began mass production of what it calls the world's first 47uF MLCC in 1005M size (1.0 x 0.5 mm) and commercialised what it calls the world's first automotive noise-suppression ferrite bead for C-V2X communication (5.9 GHz band). In Devices and Modules it commercialised what it calls the world's first ultra-low-transmission-loss LCP flexible substrate with a hollow structure and the world's first RF filter using XBAR technology for the communications market, and for automotive the world's first resin-molded, wire-bonding-compatible NTC thermistor for power semiconductors. Development themes include RF devices and next-generation components for 6G, AI and vehicle electrification.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 158,870 million; 47uF MLCC in 1005M size (1.0 x 0.5 mm) in mass production
